description: Share of renewable fuel used in collecting waste is a dataset listed in Opendataumea open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Vatten- och avfallskompetens i norr AB. Share of renewable fuel used in collecting waste. Coverage: Umeå. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are Reneable fuel. The portal shows 54 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-umea-se-portal.
